seeded-research-session.description: One research session seeded via holo seed:e2e --reset whose workflow advances 1->5 iterations; progress row research_sessions is in zero_pub
records: holo seed:e2e --reset creates a research_sessions row with status='running', max_iterations=5, current_iteration starting at 1
research_sessions is a full-table zero_pub member (zero-pub.ts:26)
the Sprint 17 research engine increments current_iteration as the workflow advances
a Zero useQuery reads current_iteration and max_iterations reactively

scenario.verification_service: Maestro + Zero + seeded Postgres + named iOS Simulator

would_fail_if: disconnect — Zero socket down or WAL replay broken
stub — progress bar reads from a static array or mocked useQuery
empty — research_sessions not in zero_pub or useQuery returns null
mock — Maestro flow skipped and progress screenshot faked

steps: start the research session via app UI or seeded fixture
wait for the Sprint 17 workflow to advance iterations 1->2->3
observe the progress bar update without manual refresh

must_observe: the bar advances from `1/5` to `3/5` with `0` manual refreshes
Maestro exit code `0` with screenshot evidence
must_not_observe: the progress stuck at `1/5` (Zero sync failed, `0` advances)
a hardcoded `3/5` with `0` real Postgres column backing (stub)

would_fail_if: stub — app/zero/schema.ts omits the progress columns
empty — app/zero/queries.ts lacks the researchSessionById query

must_observe: the design notes cite the `research_sessions` table name
